sentence: The cost was greater than we expected.
zh-TW: 費用比我們預期的還高。
tagging_notes: greater than 在此為「大於；多於」

sentence: Do you happen to know her number?
zh-TW: 你剛好知道她的電話號碼嗎？

sentence: The court held that the contract was valid.
zh-TW: 法院認定這份合約有效。
tagging_notes: held that 在此為「認為；裁定」

sentence: Faced with a long wait, we took a taxi.
zh-TW: 面對漫長的等待，我們改搭計程車。

sentence: Wash your hands, and keep doing so all day.
zh-TW: 洗手，而且整天都要保持這樣做。

sentence: We set off early to avoid the traffic.
zh-TW: 我們很早就出發，以避開塞車。
tagging_notes: set off 在此為「出發」

sentence: She put forward a new idea at the meeting.
zh-TW: 她在會議上提出了一個新點子。

sentence: I still call my old teacher from time to time.
zh-TW: 我偶爾還是會打電話給以前的老師。

sentence: We don't have the means to buy a house.
zh-TW: 我們沒有能力買房子。
tagging_notes: the means 在此為「財力；手段」

sentence: I've lived here ever since I was a child.
zh-TW: 我從小就一直住在這裡。

sentence: Dinner is just about ready.
zh-TW: 晚餐差不多好了。

sentence: I prefer tea, as opposed to coffee.
zh-TW: 比起咖啡，我比較喜歡茶。

sentence: Small mistakes can give rise to big problems.
zh-TW: 小錯誤可能會引發大問題。

sentence: The city is planning a large-scale cleanup.
zh-TW: 市政府正在規劃一次大規模的清潔活動。

sentence: That doesn't make sense to me.
zh-TW: 我覺得那說不通。

sentence: The data is sent by means of a secure link.
zh-TW: 資料是透過安全連結傳送的。

sentence: In short, the trip was a success.
zh-TW: 簡單來說，這趟旅行很成功。

sentence: It's a bit of a problem for us.
zh-TW: 這對我們來說有點麻煩。

sentence: Tom and Lisa broke up last month.
zh-TW: Tom 和 Lisa 上個月分手了。
tagging_notes: break up 在此為「分手」

sentence: It's expensive, but then again, it lasts for years.
zh-TW: 它很貴，不過話說回來，可以用好多年。

sentence: I know that feeling all too well.
zh-TW: 我太了解那種感覺了。

sentence: I can't put up with this noise anymore.
zh-TW: 我再也受不了這噪音了。
tagging_notes: put up 在此為「忍受」（put up with）

sentence: She's really good at math.
zh-TW: 她數學真的很好。

sentence: The station is a long way from here.
zh-TW: 車站離這裡很遠。

sentence: The repairs amount to about 500 dollars.
zh-TW: 修理費總共大約五百美元。
tagging_notes: amount to 在此為「累計達」

sentence: I can't stay for long tonight.
zh-TW: 我今晚不能待太久。

sentence: The cafe is run by two sisters.
zh-TW: 這家咖啡店由兩姊妹經營。

sentence: Would you like some more rice?
zh-TW: 你要再來點飯嗎？

sentence: In the absence of the manager, Lisa is in charge.
zh-TW: 經理不在時，由 Lisa 負責。

sentence: The market sells all sorts of fruit.
zh-TW: 市場賣各式各樣的水果。

sentence: Let's get on with the meeting.
zh-TW: 我們繼續開會吧。
tagging_notes: get on with 在此為「繼續做」

sentence: This pen is no good. It doesn't write.
zh-TW: 這支筆不能用了，寫不出來。

sentence: The train is late yet another time.
zh-TW: 火車又一次誤點了。

sentence: Practice is the key to learning a language.
zh-TW: 練習是學好語言的關鍵。

sentence: I'm afraid we're fully booked tonight.
zh-TW: 恐怕我們今晚已經客滿了。

sentence: We value that which is hard to replace.
zh-TW: 我們珍惜那些難以取代的東西。
tagging_notes: 正式書面用法

sentence: Are you free tomorrow? If so, let's meet.
zh-TW: 你明天有空嗎？如果有，我們見個面吧。

sentence: I'm busy right now. Can I call you back?
zh-TW: 我現在很忙，可以晚點回電給你嗎？

sentence: In view of the weather, the event was canceled.
zh-TW: 鑒於天氣狀況，活動取消了。

sentence: Please explain the plan in detail.
zh-TW: 請詳細說明這個計畫。

sentence: Her hard work is reflected in her grades.
zh-TW: 她的努力反映在她的成績上。

sentence: There's no such thing as a free lunch.
zh-TW: 天下沒有白吃的午餐。

sentence: He's done nothing but complain all day.
zh-TW: 他整天只會抱怨。

sentence: She stayed calm in the face of danger.
zh-TW: 她面對危險時保持冷靜。

sentence: The pain was such that he couldn't sleep.
zh-TW: 痛得他睡不著覺。

sentence: She helped him out of kindness.
zh-TW: 她出於好心幫助他。
tagging_notes: out of 在此為「出於（某種原因）」

sentence: Our new neighbors live next door.
zh-TW: 我們的新鄰居住在隔壁。

sentence: His speech was short and to the point.
zh-TW: 他的演講簡短又切中要點。

sentence: We slowly made our way to the exit.
zh-TW: 我們慢慢往出口走去。

sentence: Don't worry, the situation is in hand.
zh-TW: 別擔心，情況在掌控之中。

sentence: I didn't get to see the show.
zh-TW: 我沒機會看到那場表演。
tagging_notes: get to 在此為「有機會（做某事）」

sentence: By the way, have you eaten yet?
zh-TW: 對了，你吃過了嗎？

sentence: Summers here are hot. By contrast, winters are mild.
zh-TW: 這裡夏天很熱。相比之下，冬天很溫和。

sentence: We've run out of milk again.
zh-TW: 我們的牛奶又喝完了。

sentence: In principle, I agree with you.
zh-TW: 原則上，我同意你的看法。

sentence: The rain only added to our stress.
zh-TW: 下雨只讓我們更有壓力。
tagging_notes: add to 在此為「使更加」

sentence: We have no answer as yet.
zh-TW: 我們至今還沒有答覆。

sentence: Smokers are at risk of heart disease.
zh-TW: 吸菸者有罹患心臟病的風險。

sentence: The hotel is a mere five minutes from the beach.
zh-TW: 飯店離海灘只有短短五分鐘。

sentence: Exercise has been shown to improve sleep.
zh-TW: 研究顯示運動能改善睡眠。

sentence: On the one hand, it's cheap. On the other, it's far.
zh-TW: 一方面，它很便宜；另一方面，它很遠。

sentence: We flew home by way of Tokyo.
zh-TW: 我們經由東京飛回家。
tagging_notes: by way of 在此為「經由」

sentence: The band is on the road all summer.
zh-TW: 那個樂團整個夏天都在巡迴演出。
tagging_notes: on the road 在此為「巡迴中」

sentence: Bear in mind that the shop closes at six.
zh-TW: 請記得那家店六點就關門了。

sentence: My dad's phone is really old fashioned.
zh-TW: 我爸的手機真的很老舊。

sentence: Is this bike for sale?
zh-TW: 這台腳踏車要賣嗎？

sentence: Do you need a drink or anything?
zh-TW: 你需要喝點什麼或其他東西嗎？

sentence: It will most likely rain tomorrow.
zh-TW: 明天很可能會下雨。

sentence: He works hard to provide for his family.
zh-TW: 他努力工作來養家。
tagging_notes: provide for 在此為「供養」

sentence: It was raining. Even so, we went out.
zh-TW: 當時在下雨。即便如此，我們還是出門了。

sentence: I came across an old photo of us.
zh-TW: 我偶然翻到一張我們的舊照片。
tagging_notes: come across 在此為「偶然遇到」

sentence: First of all, thank you for coming.
zh-TW: 首先，謝謝大家來。

sentence: We might as well take a taxi.
zh-TW: 我們乾脆搭計程車吧。

sentence: The offer is limited to one per customer.
zh-TW: 此優惠每位顧客限購一份。

sentence: To me, this is the best pizza in town.
zh-TW: 依我看，這是城裡最好吃的披薩。
tagging_notes: to me 在此為「依我看」

sentence: It's a nice car. Mind you, it isn't cheap.
zh-TW: 那是一台好車。不過話說回來，它不便宜。
tagging_notes: mind you 在此為「不過話說回來」

sentence: Please come in one at a time.
zh-TW: 請一個一個進來。
tagging_notes: at a time 在此為「一次（幾個）」

sentence: The movie starts at half past seven.
zh-TW: 電影七點半開始。

sentence: With respect to your question, I'll check and reply.
zh-TW: 關於你的問題，我查一下再回覆你。

sentence: His story is consistent with the facts.
zh-TW: 他的說法和事實一致。

sentence: Excuse me, where's the way out?
zh-TW: 不好意思，出口在哪裡？
tagging_notes: way out 在此為「出口」

sentence: We don't share your data with any third party.
zh-TW: 我們不會把你的資料提供給任何第三方。

sentence: Contrary to the forecast, it was sunny all day.
zh-TW: 和預報相反，那天整天都是晴天。

sentence: I bought ten dollars' worth of snacks.
zh-TW: 我買了十美元的零食。

sentence: We waited a good hour for the bus.
zh-TW: 我們等公車足足等了一個小時。
tagging_notes: a good 在此為「足足（有）」

sentence: We'll act on your advice.
zh-TW: 我們會照你的建議去做。

sentence: The room is great, except that it's noisy.
zh-TW: 房間很棒，只是有點吵。

sentence: She handles the day to day running of the shop.
zh-TW: 她負責店裡的日常營運。

sentence: He was late as usual.
zh-TW: 他照例又遲到了。

sentence: I knew the answer long before she told me.
zh-TW: 早在她告訴我之前，我就知道答案了。

sentence: That all happened long ago.
zh-TW: 那些都是很久以前的事了。

sentence: The event is held in conjunction with the city.
zh-TW: 這項活動是與市政府合辦的。

sentence: Keep your phone up to date.
zh-TW: 記得讓你的手機保持最新版本。

sentence: I can't boil an egg, let alone cook dinner.
zh-TW: 我連水煮蛋都不會，更別說煮晚餐了。

sentence: I've traveled quite a lot this year.
zh-TW: 我今年旅行了相當多次。

sentence: We can go now, if you like.
zh-TW: 如果你願意，我們現在就可以走。

sentence: I'll help, to the extent that I can.
zh-TW: 我會在能力範圍內幫忙。

sentence: So far as I know, the store is still open.
zh-TW: 就我所知，那家店還開著。

sentence: Given that it's late, let's order in.
zh-TW: 既然很晚了，我們叫外送吧。

sentence: Prices rose in line with costs.
zh-TW: 價格隨著成本同步上漲。
